core_claim: It is not that men in 2019 sing higher than men used to — the all-songs average is below 1958. It is that the very top of the chart suddenly demands a high voice, opening a 1.65-point register gap between hits and merely-charting songs that has never existed before.
headline: The Top of the Charts Sang Higher in 2019 Than in Any Year Since 1958
subhead: Pop's average voice barely moved. The voice that wins the chart did.
